query:
-- Free in slot 9 (Symphony Talent replacement)
SELECT dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company
FROM delegateProfiles dp
WHERE dp.attendeeId NOT IN (
  SELECT attendeeId FROM meetings WHERE timeSlot = 9 AND status IN ('confirmed','suggested')
) AND dp.attendeeId != '9319401'
ORDER BY dp.lastName;
